🎬 The Night Of (2016) — Crime, Drama

The Night Of (2016) is a gripping crime drama that follows Nasir “Naz” Khan, a young college student whose life changes completely after one night in New York City.
After meeting a woman and spending the evening with her, Naz wakes up to discover that she has been killed, leaving him at the center of a serious criminal investigation.

With little understanding of what happened, Naz is arrested and thrown into the complicated American justice system. As the case develops, lawyer John Stone takes on his defense and begins uncovering details that make the truth increasingly difficult to determine.

 The experience forces Naz to confront a world of suspicion, fear, and consequences far beyond anything he had imagined.

The series explores themes of justice, prejudice, incarceration, identity, and how quickly a person's life can change because of one decision. It also questions whether the legal system can truly reveal the truth when evidence, public opinion, and personal assumptions all collide.

More than just a crime drama, The Night Of is a thought-provoking story about how one night can transform a person's identity and future. ❤️‍🩹
